subject: general
question: Sanchi stupa is located in which states?
solution:
The correct answer is __Madhya Pradesh__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​Sanchi Stupa:

 
 
• Sanchi is about 50 km from Bhopal, the capital of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Stupa at Sanchi is a world heritage site. 
 
• It was built by Ashoka in the 3rd century BCE.
 
• It is the most prominent and the oldest and is believed to have the Buddha’s relics.
 
• Along with other relatively small stupas, there are three main stupas at Sanchi.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.britannica.com/36/155836-050-89E7AA9E/Great-Stupa-Sanchi-India.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
 
• It is a religious place with historical and archaeological significance.

 
 
• Sanchi is famous in the world for stupas, monolithic Asokan pillar, temples, monasteries and sculptural wealth dating from 3rd century B.C. to 12th century A.D.
 
• During Sunga times, several edifices were raised at Sanchi and its surrounding hills.
